storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Cozy Story
storyTemplate.description: A cozy start: arrive at a quiet cottage and prepare the place before the first neighbor visits.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The cottage key is warm from your pocket when you reach the garden gate.

Moss grows between the stones, bees drift through lavender, and a little porch bell turns in the breeze. The windows are dusty, but the roof is sound, and smoke from a neighbor's chimney curls over the hill.

Before anyone comes to welcome you, the cottage needs opening.
